185:     if (!tex) return;

229:         if ((c === LADDER || rope) && start < 0) start = row;
230:         if (c !== LADDER && !rope && start >= 0) {
231:           const climb: Climbable = { col, top: start, bottom: row - 1, rope };

242: private drawClimbable(c: Climbable) {
243:     const top = c.top * TILE;
244:     const bottom = (c.bottom + 1) * TILE;
245:     const x = c.col * TILE + TILE / 2;
246:     const g = this.add.graphics().setDepth(8);
247:     const wood = c.rope ? 0x9a7440 : 0xc9a25e;
248:     const shade = c.rope ? 0x6a4c26 : 0x8a6a3c;
249:     if (c.rope) {
250:       g.lineStyle(3, wood, 1).lineBetween(x, top, x, bottom);
251:       g.fillStyle(shade, 1).fillCircle(x, bottom - 4, 4);
252:       return;
253:     }
254:     // Two rails and the rungs between them.
255:     for (const dx of [-8, 8]) {
256:       g.fillStyle(shade, 1).fillRect(x + dx - 1.5, top, 3, bottom - top);
257:       g.fillStyle(wood, 1).fillRect(x + dx - 1, top, 2, bottom - top);
258:     }
259:     for (let y = top + 8; y < bottom - 2; y += 11) {
260:       g.fillStyle(shade, 1).fillRect(x - 10, y, 20, 4);
261:       g.fillStyle(wood, 1).fillRect(x - 9, y + 1, 18, 2);

268:       for (let col = 0; col < COLS; col++) {
269:         if (this.grid[row][col] !== CRUMBLE) continue;

282:       for (let col = 0; col < COLS; col++) {

317:           this.pickups.push({ sprite, kind: t[1], points: t[2], carry: t[3] });

328:     if (!e) return;

343:       this.add.rectangle(x, y, TILE, TILE, 0x0d0809).setDepth(28);

346:       frame.lineStyle(2, DOOR_TINT[d.colour], 0.85);

349:       const zone = this.add
350:         .rectangle(d.dir === 'left' ? x + TILE / 2 + 4 : x - TILE / 2 - 4, y, 16, TILE + 8, 0xffffff, 0)
351:         .setDepth(31);
352:       this.doors.push({ ...d, view, zone });

356:   private buildCreatures() {
357:     const place = (kind: 'skull' | 'skeleton', col: number, row: number) => {
358:       const name = kind === 'skull' ? 'skull' : 'skeleton';
359:       const e = manifest(this)?.sprites[name];
360:       if (!e || !this.textures.exists(e.textureKey)) return;
361:       const { x, y } = this.centre(col, row);
362:       const view = this.add.sprite(x, y, e.textureKey).setDepth(55);
363:       const mover = new Mover();
364:       mover.x = x;
365:       mover.y = (row + 1) * TILE;
366:       mover.w = kind === 'skull' ? 20 : 22;
367:       mover.h = kind === 'skull' ? 22 : 46;

369:       view.setPosition(mover.x, mover.y - mover.h);
370:       this.creatures.push({ mover, view, kind, dir: col % 2 ? 1 : -1, dead: false, spent: false });

A Phaser 3 remake of Parker Brothers' *Montezuma's Revenge* (Robert Jaeger, 1984). Panama Joe climbs down into an

npm run dev         # http://localhost:5197
